Definition: from G473 and G3083; a redemption-price:--ransom.
BiblicalUsage: Paul calls Christ Jesus the one mediator who gave Himself a ransom for all, to be testified in due time. The word is the redemption price itself, the payment made in place of the captive.
TheologicalSignificance: A single word for a ransom price carries no system of its own; its weight is Paul's, that Christ gave Himself as the price for all.
